content:
Is there documentation that gives an overview about the github actions that run when PRing things into mathlib and the purpose of each one? That would be more convenient than digging through the runs and what each does.

Regarding contributions guidelines , specifically the 'Making a pull request heading' https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/index.html#making-a-pull-request-pr :
It mentions 'If you are moving or deleting declarations, please include these lines at the bottom of the commit message (that is, before the ---) using the following format:' but doesn't talk about adding deprecations or scripts/add_deprecation.sh. Moreover , isn't this currently redundant to do because currently there's a github action that runs giving the following output:

PR summary some_hash
Import changes for modified files

No significant changes to the import graph
Import changes for all files
Files   Import difference

Declarations diff
....

where declarations diff would show whats added and deleted.
